currentEvidence.method: seven bounded foreground read-only Ghidra packets, including raw current-image word queries after thunk-truncated decompilation and listing, followed by narrow exact-function generated-code corroboration

entries.result: Raw words close the player, UnitType, stride, base-field, and sign-extension inputs.
All eight exact words are direct calls to the accepted accessors; only 0x82CDA214 and 0x82CDA234 form the accepted participant core pair.
The windows consume attack and defense values without proving the core combat pair's two-player role carrier.
AITurnUnitFilter directly calls CombatResolve in mode 1 for its incoming player/unit with provisional defender inputs -1/-1, then consumes the returned value through exact evaluation thresholds.

CombatResolve retains the incoming attacker identity and, on the continuing opponent-present path, fills the accepted defender player/unit locals through two bounded direct producer calls before the ordered core stat pair.

currentEvidence.qualification: The canonical Ghidra project truncates the affected Xenon functions after save thunks. Raw current-image words are authoritative for the promoted instruction claims; generated code only corroborates the already-identified bounded functions and callsites.

runtimeBoundary.result: The accepted unit-stats probe observed attack for an attacker and defense for a human defender during AI combat. That corroborates resolver consumption, not execution of the statically mapped AITurnUnitFilter prediction call. No game was launched for this continuation.

guards: Treat attack-side and defense-side as derived states of the exact core callsites, not as a stored guest enum or another scalar ABI property.
Do not assign the core role to every call of either effective stat accessor inside CombatResolve.
Do not infer an opposing unit class from UnitType dataflow or literal 25; the nearby special branch is outside this packet.

Do not claim general AI evaluation parity from shared scalar accessors or from the one resolver-backed AITurnUnitFilter prediction call. The three scalar windows still do not expose a two-player role carrier.

Do not widen this finding into healing, March, Veteran status, movement, extra actions, post-combat advance, upgrades, promotion persistence, animation, presentation, networking, API, hook, or production behavior.
conclusion: The accepted ordinary unit-versus-unit resolver contains one exact two-state combat-stat role: it obtains attacker effective attack at 0x82CDA214, then defender effective defense at 0x82CDA234, and retains the results separately. The role is derived from those callsites; neither shared accessor accepts a role or opponent input. AITurnUnitFilter contains one exact resolver-backed prediction call at 0x82CC03FC that starts from its incoming attacker player/unit. On the continuing opponent-present path, the resolver derives the accepted defender player/unit, reaches the ordered core pair, and returns an evaluation value consumed by the caller. This closes one bounded AI-role relation, not general parity for the other AI evaluators or every resolver path.
